description: Author the Gitea + hosting IaC and wire the Gitea-backed github Lambda per design §B.4 (CDK side), §C, §D.2 (CDK side), and §E. Port the GiteaBackend into the github Lambda behind GITHUB_MODE=real (mock stays the DEFAULT, 94 tests stay green); add two new CDK stacks (MahaloGiteaStack = EC2+EBS+VPC+SG+SSM refs; MahaloFrontendStack = private S3 + CloudFront single S3 origin + flag-gated BucketDeployment + Cognito unauthenticated identity pool/role); add FunctionUrlCorsOptions to MahaloApiStack (auth stays AWS_IAM); port the Gitea bootstrap assets into gitea/; and write the deferred operator deploy runbook. This feature is INDEPENDENT of FEAT-001 (it touches only Python CDK + the github Lambda + gitea/ + docs; never frontend/src). Everything synths OFFLINE Docker-free and cred-free with asset builds flag-gated; NO deploy is run.
steps: Read docs/.agents/tasks/task7-design.md §B.4, §C (C.1-C.7, esp. C.4 and C.4b), §D.2, §E and this task7-feats/context.json FIRST. Do NOT re-decide architecture. Activate the infra-cdk .venv before running cdk/pytest there.

Port the Gitea adapter into tools-lambdas/github/ from READ-ONLY d:/<USER>/LavaCode/AI/mahalo-dock/mock-services/github/: create gitea_backend.py (port gitea_backend.py — repo_id==repo name under one owner, _publicize base_url->public_url rewrite, _write_file via the Gitea contents API) and backend_base.py (GithubBackend/BackendError) if not already shareable. Adapt imports to the tools-lambdas/common/ layout; keep httpx as the HTTP client.

Edit tools-lambdas/github/routes.py (design §C.4): ADD a new `build_gitea_router(backend)` that registers the SAME route table as build_router but delegates each route to the GiteaBackend instance and maps BackendError to the common `error(status, detail)` helper. Leave `build_router(store, token)` and its signature/mock behavior UNCHANGED (do not alter any mock-path line).

Edit tools-lambdas/github/handler.py (design §C.4): add module-scope `_MODE = os.environ.get('GITHUB_MODE', 'mock').strip().lower()` plus Gitea env constants `_GITEA_URL` (GITEA_URL), `_GITEA_OWNER` (GITEA_ADMIN_USER), `_GITEA_PUBLIC_URL` (GITEA_PUBLIC_URL), `_DEMO_DEVELOPER_ID` (DEMO_DEVELOPER_ID default 'dev-6'), and token resolution `_GITEA_TOKEN` from SSM: if `GITEA_TOKEN_PARAM` is set, resolve once at cold start via boto3 `ssm.get_parameter(Name=..., WithDecryption=True)` and cache at module scope, else fall back to GITEA_TOKEN/GITEA_TOKEN_FILE. Change `_get_router()` so when `_MODE == 'real'` it does NOT construct/seed the DynamoDB Store (returns `(None, build_gitea_router(GiteaBackend(...)))`); when unset/'mock' it runs the existing Store + build_router path UNCHANGED. In lambda_handler guard `store.ensure_seeded()` behind `store is not None`. Never log the token value.

Add real-mode unit tests in tools-lambdas/tests/test_github_handler.py (design §C.7): mock the httpx transport (no live Gitea) and assert the contract translation (repo_id->name path, _publicize URL rewrite, author-id mapping) and that mock mode is untouched. These are part of the offline gate.
Run `pytest tools-lambdas/tests -q` (with moto installed in the test venv) and confirm `94 passed` for the existing suite PLUS the new real-mode tests, with no existing test setting GITHUB_MODE=real.

Edit infra-cdk/mahalo_infra/mock_service_stack.py (design §C.4b): add three optional kwargs `gitea_mode: bool = False`, `gitea_env: dict[str,str] | None = None`, `gitea_token_param_name: str | None = None`. Inside __init__, after building the base env dict, add a branch GUARDED by `service == 'github' and gitea_mode` that sets env['GITHUB_MODE']='real' and merges gitea_env; and a SSM read-grant branch with the SAME guard plus `gitea_token_param_name` that does `ssm.StringParameter.from_secure_string_parameter_attributes(...).grant_read(fn)`. Defaults MUST leave all four instances byte-identical to today.

Edit infra-cdk/app.py (design §C.4b, §E.1): read `gitea_mode = app.node.try_get_context('giteaMode') == 'real'` once; in the service loop pass gitea_mode/gitea_env/gitea_token_param_name to the github instance ONLY (False/None for the other three), using module-level constants `_GITEA_ENV` (GITEA_URL/GITEA_ADMIN_USER/GITEA_PUBLIC_URL/DEMO_DEVELOPER_ID) and `_GITEA_TOKEN_PARAM` (the SSM parameter name). Then add two new stacks after MahaloApiStack by DIRECT construct reference: MahaloGiteaStack(app, 'MahaloGiteaStack', env=_ENV) and MahaloFrontendStack(app, 'MahaloFrontendStack', api_stack=<the api stack construct>, env=_ENV).

Create infra-cdk/mahalo_infra/gitea_stack.py = MahaloGiteaStack (design §C.2/§C.3/§C.5): a tiny dedicated aws_ec2.Vpc (1 public subnet, no NAT, created NOT from_lookup); an aws_ec2.Instance (Amazon Linux 2023, t3.small, public subnet, public IP) whose UserData installs Docker and runs `docker run -d -p 3000:3000 -v /data/gitea:/data gitea/gitea:1.27.3` (image BY REFERENCE — no DockerImageAsset) and runs the gitea/ bootstrap one-shot after the server is healthy; an aws_ec2.SecurityGroup with SSH(22) ingress restricted to a CfnParameter `AdminCidr` (no 0.0.0.0/0 default) and Gitea(3000) ingress defaulting to 0.0.0.0/0 via an optional CfnParameter `GiteaIngressCidr` (default 0.0.0.0/0); a dedicated gp3 EBS volume mounted at /data with RemovalPolicy.DESTROY (overridable to RETAIN via a `RetainGiteaData` CfnParameter); and references (not literal values) to SSM SecureString parameter names for the adapter token + admin password. Emit useful CfnOutputs (public URL). NO fromLookup anywhere.

Create infra-cdk/mahalo_infra/frontend_stack.py = MahaloFrontendStack (design §D.2, §B.2): a private aws_s3.Bucket (RemovalPolicy.DESTROY, auto_delete_objects=True, no public access); an aws_cloudfront.Distribution with a SINGLE default behavior to the S3 origin via OAC, SPA 403/404->index.html, and NO API/Function-URL origin; a flag-gated aws_s3_deployment.BucketDeployment behind `-c buildFrontend=1`/MAHALO_BUILD_FRONTEND=1 (offline branch uses a placeholder/empty source or skips the deployment so synth needs no prior next build, mirroring the -c buildImage=1 pattern in api_stack.py); an aws_cognito.CfnIdentityPool(allow_unauthenticated_identities=True) + aws_iam.Role (web-identity trust on cognito-identity.amazonaws.com, inline policy granting ONLY lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl on api_stack.function.function_arn) + CfnIdentityPoolRoleAttachment binding the unauthenticated role. Take api_stack as a constructor arg ONLY to read api_stack.function.function_arn (do NOT read any function_url string — none is exposed). Emit CfnOutput `IdentityPoolId` and CfnOutput `FrontendUrl` (the CloudFront domain).

Edit infra-cdk/mahalo_infra/api_stack.py (design §B.4): add a `cors=FunctionUrlCorsOptions(...)` block to the existing `fn.add_function_url(auth_type=AWS_IAM)` call — allowed_origins = the CloudFront frontend origin (a CfnParameter, NOT '*'), allowed_methods = POST/GET/OPTIONS, allowed_headers = Authorization, X-Amz-Date, X-Amz-Security-Token, X-Amz-Content-Sha256, Content-Type, max_age ~300s. The auth type stays AWS_IAM (no downgrade). This is the ONE edit to the Task-6 API stack.

Port the Gitea bootstrap assets into gitea/ (design §C.3) from READ-ONLY mahalo-dock/mock-services/gitea-bootstrap/: bootstrap.sh (create first admin via the gitea CLI, mint the adapter token with scopes write:repository/write:user/read:organization, seed the payment-service repo, push the token to the SSM SecureString instead of the Compose shared-volume file, set GITEA_PUBLIC_URL to the instance browser-facing URL) and its Dockerfile. Keep it idempotent.

Add CDK synth assertion tests under infra-cdk/tests/ following test_synth.py / test_api_stack.py patterns: test_gitea_stack.py (VPC created not looked up, EC2 instance present, SG has SSH restricted + 3000 ingress, EBS volume, no DockerImageAsset); test_frontend_stack.py (distribution has a SINGLE S3 origin and no Function-URL origin, bucket is private, identity pool + unauthenticated role present with lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl, CfnOutputs IdentityPoolId + FrontendUrl); extend test_api_stack.py to assert add_function_url still has AuthType=AWS_IAM AND now carries the cors block with the expected methods/headers.

Run the infra offline gate from infra-cdk/ (its .venv active): `cdk synth --all` MUST exit 0 with NO Docker and NO AWS creds and produce 10 templates (was 8); then `pytest tests -q` all passing (prior baseline 42 passed/1 skipped plus the new assertions). Also re-run `pytest tools-lambdas/tests -q` to confirm 94 + new real-mode tests. If agent/ or api/app were accidentally touched (they should NOT be — only api_stack.py), run `pytest agent -q` (NO MAHALO_* env vars) expecting 99/1 and `pytest api -q` expecting 15.

Create docs/.agents/tasks/task7-deploy-runbook.md documenting the DEFERRED live operator steps (design §E.4, §D.2): create the SSM SecureString params; cdk deploy MahaloGiteaStack; confirm Gitea healthy + seed repo; cdk deploy MahaloMockGithubStack -c giteaMode=real; the ordered frontend deploy (deploy MahaloApiStack -> read RuntimeApiUrl; deploy MahaloFrontendStack without -c buildFrontend=1 -> read IdentityPoolId + CloudFront domain; set NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL/NEXT_PUBLIC_AWS_REGION/NEXT_PUBLIC_COGNITO_IDENTITY_POOL_ID and npm run build; deploy MahaloFrontendStack -c buildFrontend=1; re-deploy MahaloApiStack so CORS allowed_origins includes the CloudFront domain); then the end-to-end smoke test. Make clear NONE of this is run in the offline gate.

Set this FEAT-002 status to 'completed' and write into findings: the cdk synth template count (expect 10), the infra-cdk and tools-lambdas test counts, and any deviation from the design. Commit locally on the branch (do NOT push).
acceptance_criteria: `cdk synth --all` from infra-cdk/ exits 0 with NO Docker invocation and NO AWS credentials and emits 10 CloudFormation templates (the 8 existing + MahaloGiteaStack + MahaloFrontendStack).

With `giteaMode` context unset, the four MockServiceStack instances synth byte-identical to before (github env still just {TABLE_NAME, MOCK_GITHUB_TOKEN}), and `cdk synth -c giteaMode=real` adds GITHUB_MODE=real + Gitea env + the SSM read grant to the github instance ONLY.
`pytest tools-lambdas/tests -q` == 94 passed for the existing suite PLUS new real-mode tests (httpx mocked); mock mode is the default and unchanged.
`pytest tests -q` in infra-cdk/ passes including new test_gitea_stack.py / test_frontend_stack.py and the extended api_stack CORS assertion; api_stack Function URL is still AuthType=AWS_IAM.
gitea/ contains the ported bootstrap.sh + Dockerfile; tools-lambdas/github/ contains gitea_backend.py (+ backend_base.py) behind GITHUB_MODE=real; docs/.agents/tasks/task7-deploy-runbook.md exists.
No file under d:/<USER>/LavaCode/AI/mahalo-dock was modified; no cdk deploy/bootstrap was run.
verification: From infra-cdk/ (.venv active): `cdk synth --all` exit 0 offline, then confirm 10 templates in cdk.out (e.g. count the *.template.json), then `pytest tests -q` passing.
`pytest tools-lambdas/tests -q` == 94 + new real-mode tests, all passing.
`cdk synth -c giteaMode=real` succeeds offline and the github template gains GITHUB_MODE=real while the jira/confluence/servicenow templates are unchanged.
findings: DONE. cdk synth --all offline (Docker-free, cred-free) exits 0 and emits 10 *.template.json files in cdk.out (8 existing + MahaloGiteaStack + MahaloFrontendStack). No DockerImageAsset in either new stack (Gitea image referenced by tag gitea/gitea:1.27.3 in UserData). TESTS: tools-lambdas `pytest tests -q` = 103 passed (94 baseline + 9 new real-mode tests: GiteaBackend repo_id->name path, _publicize URL rewrite, owner->dev-6 author mapping + non-owner passthrough, merged state, BackendError->status, 404/409 mapping, handler real-mode health reports mode=real with no DynamoDB Store, list_repos through the router with auth still enforced, SSM GITEA_TOKEN_PARAM cold-start resolution, and a mock-mode-unaffected sanity check). No test sets GITHUB_MODE=real on the mock fixture; the default github template has NO GITHUB_MODE (byte-identical), and `cdk synth -c giteaMode=real` adds GITHUB_MODE=real + the Gitea env + the ssm:GetParameter/GiteaToken read-grant to the github instance ONLY (jira/confluence/servicenow unchanged). infra-cdk `pytest tests -q` = 57 passed / 1 skipped (42 baseline + 15 new: 1 CORS assertion on api_stack, 7 in test_gitea_stack.py, 7 in test_frontend_stack.py). api_stack Function URL stays AuthType=AWS_IAM with the added CORS block. agent/ and api/app were NOT touched (only api_stack.py), so their suites were not re-run. DEVIATIONS: (1) Function URL CORS allowed_methods is [POST, GET] — OPTIONS was dropped because CloudFormation rejects 'OPTIONS' as an allowed-method value for a Lambda Function URL (it exceeds the 6-char enum and is not in the allowed set); the OPTIONS preflight is answered automatically/unsigned by the Function URL CORS layer, so the design §B.4 intent (unsigned preflight, signed POST/GET) still holds. (2) MahaloGiteaStack overrides availability_zones to [<region>a] so the dedicated ec2.Vpc needs NO AZ context lookup (an un-overridden Vpc triggers an AWS call that breaks the offline gate); this stays lookup-free per §E.2. (3) The gitea bootstrap token push was adapted from the Compose shared-volume file to an SSM SecureString (GITEA_TOKEN_SSM_PARAM / `aws ssm put-parameter`), with the token-file write kept as an optional local-parity fallback, per §C.3. (4) UserData runs the Gitea server container and waits for health, leaving a BOOTSTRAP_READY marker; the one-shot bootstrap.sh seed+token-push is documented as the operator step in the runbook (design §C.3/§E.4). httpx==0.28.1 was added to tools-lambdas/requirements-dev.txt and installed into the test venv (new runtime dep for the real-mode adapter; imported lazily so the mock path never loads it).
